answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind each identity to an escalating quadratic stake burn, where minting $N$ replicas imposes superlinear collateral destruction scaling as $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$. While an honest agent treats its staked deposit as a vital oasis for sustained operation, an attacker discovers past deposits turn into a forfeited relic upon coordination breach. Slashing scales to a zenith where exponential costs bankrupt counterfeit swarms.
